body_zh: 城北光伏电站的运行日报显示，上周三全站发电约3万千瓦时，比前一天多出百分之八。日照时间累计7小时，组件表面温度最高达到31度，站内12台逆变器全部运行正常，没有出现停机记录。
body_en: The daily operating report of a solar power station on the north side of the city shows that last Wednesday the station generated about thirty thousand kilowatt hours, eight percent more than the day before. Sunshine added up to 7 hours, the panel surface temperature peaked at 31 degrees Celsius, and all 12 inverters at the station ran normally, with no shutdowns recorded.

body_zh: 一栋三层办公楼十月份用电8600千瓦时，其中空调约占四成，照明约占两成。与九月相比，总用电量减少了900千瓦时，减少的部分主要来自空调，因为月中以后气温回落，空调每天的开启时间明显缩短。
body_en: An office building with three floors used 8600 kilowatt hours of electricity in October, with air conditioning taking about forty percent and lighting about twenty percent. Compared with September, total use fell by 900 kilowatt hours, mostly from air conditioning, because temperatures dropped after the middle of the month and the air conditioners ran for noticeably shorter hours each day.

body_zh: 山谷里的这座小型水电站紧挨着一条河流，厂房是一栋灰色的两层建筑，屋顶铺着深色瓦片。厂房内并排安装着两台水轮发电机组，机组旁边立着一排控制柜，柜门上贴着设备编号，下方还标着最近一次的检修日期。
body_en: The small hydropower station in the valley sits right beside a river, and its powerhouse is a gray building of two floors with a roof of dark tiles. Inside, two hydroelectric generating units are installed side by side, a row of control cabinets stands next to them, and each cabinet door carries an equipment number, with the date of the latest overhaul marked below it.

body_zh: 小区门口有一间配电房，墙面刷成浅绿色，铁门上挂着一块黄色的警示牌。房间中间摆着三台变压器，四周是排列整齐的开关柜，地面铺着黑色的绝缘胶垫，角落里放着一个灭火器和一本巡检登记簿。
body_en: At the gate of the residential compound there is a power distribution room with pale green walls and a yellow warning sign hanging on its iron door. Three transformers stand in the middle of the room, surrounded by neatly arranged switch cabinets, the floor is covered with black insulating mats, and a fire extinguisher and an inspection logbook sit in one corner.

body_zh: 燃气电站的机组启动前，值班人员先检查燃料管路和冷却水压力，然后投入盘车装置，让转子缓慢转动。点火之后转速逐步升高，到达额定转速时机组并入电网，此后负荷一点点增加，直到出力达到调度给定的数值。
body_en: Before a unit at a gas power plant starts up, the operators first check the fuel lines and the cooling water pressure, then engage the turning gear so that the rotor turns slowly. After ignition the speed rises step by step, the unit is connected to the grid when it reaches rated speed, and the load is then raised little by little until the output reaches the value set by the dispatchers.

body_zh: 线路检修当天，调度中心首先下令停电，两端变电站随即断开开关。检修班组到达现场后验电并挂设接地线，接着更换老化的绝缘子。作业结束时，班组拆除接地线并清点工具，线路在傍晚恢复送电。
body_en: On the day of the line maintenance, the dispatch center first ordered a power cut, and the substations at both ends opened their switches right away. After reaching the site, the maintenance crew tested for voltage and attached grounding wires, then replaced the aged insulators. When the work was finished, the crew removed the grounding wires and counted their tools, and power returned to the line in the evening.

body_zh: 一场大风吹断了郊外线路旁的一根树枝，树枝搭在导线上，附近三个村庄随即停电。抢修队伍在40分钟后赶到现场，清除树枝并检查了导线，当晚7点左右，三个村庄全部恢复供电。
body_en: A strong wind snapped a tree branch beside a power line on the outskirts of town, the branch fell across the conductors, and three nearby villages lost power at once. A repair crew reached the scene 40 minutes later, cleared the branch and checked the conductors, and at about 7 that evening all three villages had their power back.

body_zh: 例行巡视途中，一名巡检员注意到变电站一处隔离开关的接头温度偏高，红外测温仪显示它比相邻接头高出20度。运维班组当晚安排停电处理，更换了接头螺栓，第二天复测时，温度已经恢复正常。
body_en: During a routine patrol, an inspector noticed that a joint on a disconnect switch at a substation was running hot, and an infrared thermometer showed it to be 20 degrees Celsius warmer than the neighboring joints. That evening the maintenance team scheduled an outage to deal with it and replaced the joint bolts, and when it was measured again the next day, the temperature was back to normal.

body_zh: 电网频率的高低反映着发电与用电是否平衡。用电负荷突然增加而发电出力没有跟上时，频率就会下降，反过来则会上升。为了让频率保持稳定，调度部门会安排一部分机组随时调整出力，这类机组通常叫作调频机组。
body_en: The frequency of a power grid shows whether generation and consumption are in balance. When the load rises suddenly and generation fails to keep up, the frequency falls, and in the opposite case it rises. To keep the frequency stable, dispatchers assign some generating units to adjust their output at any moment, and such units are usually called frequency regulation units.

body_zh: 不少城市对居民用电实行峰谷分时电价，白天和傍晚属于高峰时段，电价相对较高，夜里11点到次日早上7点属于低谷时段，电价较低。一些家庭因此把洗衣机和热水器的运行时间安排在夜里，每月的电费随之减少。
body_en: Many cities charge households different electricity prices at different times of day, with daytime and early evening counted as peak hours at relatively high prices, and the period from 11 at night to 7 the next morning counted as low demand hours at lower prices. Some families therefore run their washing machines and water heaters at night, and their monthly electricity bills go down as a result.

body_zh: 截至本周一，3号机房在用服务器168台，分布在24个机柜中，平均进风温度为22度。这次巡检发现2台服务器风扇转速异常，工程师当场更换了风扇，其余设备的各项指标都处在正常范围内。
body_en: As of this Monday, machine room 3 had 168 servers in service spread across 24 racks, with an average inlet air temperature of 22 degrees Celsius. This inspection found abnormal fan speeds on 2 servers, an engineer replaced the fans on the spot, and every indicator for the remaining equipment was within the normal range.

body_zh: 这款记账软件的第6版在今年3月发布，此后共推送了4次更新，修复了37个已知问题，新增了2项报表功能。最近一次更新在10月底完成，安装包比上一版小了12兆，软件启动时间从5秒左右缩短到3秒左右。
body_en: Version 6 of this bookkeeping software was released in March this year, and since then 4 updates have been pushed out, fixing 37 known problems and adding 2 reporting functions. The latest update was completed at the end of October, the installation package is 12 megabytes smaller than the previous version, and startup time has dropped from about 5 seconds to about 3 seconds.

body_zh: 地下一层的机房里，四列黑色机柜整齐排开，机柜之间用透明挡板隔出冷通道和热通道。天花板下方架着黄色的线槽，墙边立着两台精密空调，运转时发出低沉的嗡嗡声，入口处则装着门禁和一台鞋套机。
body_en: In the machine room on the first basement level, four rows of black racks stand in neat lines, with transparent panels between them separating cold aisles from hot aisles. Yellow cable trays run below the ceiling, two precision air conditioners stand by the wall and give off a low hum while running, and the entrance is fitted with an access control gate and a shoe cover machine.

body_zh: 这台机架式服务器占用两个单元的高度，前面板上排着十二个硬盘插槽，每个插槽旁都有一盏绿色状态灯。机箱背面并排装着两个电源模块和四个网口，掀开顶盖能看到两颗处理器，上面压着银色的散热片，内存条整齐地插在两侧。
body_en: This rack server takes up two units of height, its front panel holds twelve drive bays, and each bay has a green status light beside it. Two power supply units and four network ports sit side by side on the back of the chassis, and lifting the top cover reveals two processors under silver heat sinks, with memory modules lined up neatly on both sides.

body_zh: 新版本的上线分成三个阶段推进。第一阶段在测试环境里验证全部功能，第二阶段只在百分之五的服务器上部署，并连续观察两天，确认没有异常之后，第三阶段才把范围扩大到全部服务器，切换在周末的凌晨完成。
body_en: The rollout of a new version proceeds in three stages. The first stage verifies every function in a test environment, the second deploys the version on only five percent of the servers and watches them for two days in a row, and once no anomalies are found, the third stage extends it to all servers, with the switchover finished in the early hours of a weekend.

body_zh: 新服务器到货后，库管员核对序列号并贴上资产标签。装机人员把服务器推上导轨，固定在机柜的第18和第19单元，接好电源线和网线。通电自检通过以后，运维人员安装基础软件并录入资产台账，整个上架流程用时两小时左右。
body_en: When new servers arrive, the storekeeper checks the serial numbers and attaches asset labels. The installers slide each server onto its rails, fix it at units 18 and 19 of the rack, and connect the power and network cables. Once the startup check passes, the operations staff install the base software and enter the server in the asset ledger, and the whole racking procedure takes about two hours.

body_zh: 周二凌晨，一处数据中心的一路市电突然中断，不间断电源立刻接管了供电，柴油发电机在一分钟内启动。整个过程中服务器没有断电，值班人员记下了每次切换的时间，市电恢复以后，又把负载转回了原来的线路。
body_en: Early on Tuesday morning, one of the utility power feeds to a data center suddenly failed, the uninterruptible power supply took over at once, and the diesel generators started within a minute. No server lost power during the whole episode, the staff on duty noted the time of each switchover, and once utility power returned, they moved the load back to the original line.

body_zh: 一家物流公司上个月更新了仓库管理软件，更新后的第二天，几个网点反映标签打印出现乱码。技术人员查明，问题出在新版本的字体配置上，当天下午先把软件退回旧版本，三天后又发布了修正版，打印随之恢复正常。
body_en: A logistics company updated its warehouse management software last month, and on the second day after the update several branch sites reported garbled characters on printed labels. Technicians traced the problem to the font configuration in the new version, rolled the software back to the old version that afternoon, and released a corrected version three days later, after which printing returned to normal.

body_zh: 机房内的相对湿度一般控制在百分之四十到百分之六十之间。湿度过低时空气干燥，容易产生静电，可能击穿电子元件，湿度过高时，设备表面又容易凝结水珠，所以机房里通常同时配备加湿和除湿设备。
body_en: The relative humidity in a machine room is generally kept between forty and sixty percent. When humidity is too low the air is dry and static electricity builds up easily, which can damage electronic components, and when it is too high, water droplets tend to condense on equipment surfaces, so machine rooms are usually fitted with both humidifiers and dehumidifiers.

body_zh: 软件的版本号常用三组数字表示，第一组在出现较大改动时加一，第二组在增加新功能时加一，第三组只在修复问题时加一，其余两组保持不变。维护人员看到版本号的变化，就能大致判断一次更新的影响范围。
body_en: Software version numbers are often expressed as three groups of digits, where the first group goes up by one after major changes, the second goes up by one when new features are added, and the third goes up by one only when problems are fixed, with the other two left unchanged. From the change in the version number, maintainers can roughly judge the scope of an update.

body_zh: 档案室上月新收登记档案140卷，扫描和编号都已完成，其中3卷因材料缺页暂缓归档，待材料补齐后再登记。同期受理的房产档案查询共有86件，现场查询占61件，另外25件通过委托方式办理。
body_en: Last month the archive office took in 140 newly registered files and completed their scanning and numbering, although 3 files with missing pages were held back from filing and will be registered once the material is complete. Over the same period it handled 86 requests to consult property records, 61 of them made in person and the other 25 through authorized agents.

body_zh: 一份办公室租赁合同记载，租期为3年，月租金为7800元，押金相当于两个月的租金。合同约定租金每年上调百分之三，物业费由承租方承担，正文共有14条，双方在最后一页签字并加盖公章。
body_en: An office lease contract records a term of 3 years, a monthly rent of 7800 yuan and a deposit equal to two months of rent. The contract provides for a three percent rent increase each year, with property management fees paid by the tenant, its main text has 14 clauses, and both parties signed on the last page and applied their official seals.

body_zh: 这份设备买卖合同一共六页，左上角用订书钉装订，每页右下角印着页码。纸张边缘盖着一枚跨页的骑缝章，最后一页是签字栏，买卖双方的签名旁边各有一枚红色公章，日期栏里用蓝色墨水笔填着签订当天的年月日。
body_en: This equipment sales contract runs to six pages, stapled at the top left corner, with a page number printed at the bottom right of each page. A seal stamped across the page edges joins the sheets together, the last page holds the signature block, a red official seal sits beside the signature of each party, and the date line is filled in with blue ink giving the day the contract was signed.

body_zh: 存放登记档案的库房里没有窗户，常年保持恒温恒湿，里面摆着二十多排银灰色的密集架。每排架子的侧面都贴着编号标签，转动把手，架子就会沿着轨道左右移动，库房门口放着一台温湿度记录仪，旁边是一本出入登记簿。
body_en: The storeroom that holds the registration files has no windows and is kept at a constant temperature and humidity all year round, with more than twenty rows of silver gray mobile shelving inside. A number label is fixed to the side of each row, turning a handle makes the shelving slide left or right along its rails, and by the door stand a temperature and humidity recorder and, beside it, an entry and exit logbook.

body_zh: 当事人把毕业证书原件和身份证件交到公证处，学历公证的办理就此开始。公证员核对原件，并询问取得学历的经过，随后公证处向发证学校发函核实，学校确认无误后，公证员出具公证书，前后大约一周。
body_en: The notarization of academic credentials begins when the party concerned hands the original diploma and an identity document to the notary office. The notary checks the originals and asks how the qualification was obtained, the notary office then sends a letter to the issuing school for verification, and once the school confirms the details, the notary issues the notarial certificate, the whole process taking about a week.

body_zh: 一批合同档案在入库以前会经过几道整理工序。档案员把合同按签订日期排好，逐页盖上页码章，目录信息随后录入登记台账。装进档案盒以后，盒脊上标明年度和起止编号，这批档案就可以送进库房上架。
body_en: Before a batch of contract files enters the archive store, it goes through several sorting steps. The archivist arranges the contracts by signing date and stamps a page number on every page, and the catalog details are then entered in the registration ledger. Once the contracts are packed into archive boxes and each box spine is marked with the year and the first and last file numbers, the batch can be taken into the storeroom and shelved.

body_zh: 续签供货合同时，城郊一家小型印刷厂和它的纸张批发商把交货周期从十天缩短为七天，还增加了一条质量验收条款。新合同签署当天，厂方负责人把旧合同的原件交回档案室，档案员登记以后，把它装袋封存。
body_en: When renewing their supply contract, a small printing plant on the edge of town and its paper wholesaler shortened the delivery cycle from ten days to seven and added a clause on quality inspection. On the day the new contract was signed, the plant manager returned the original of the old contract to the archive room, and after registering it, an archivist placed it in a file bag and sealed it for storage.

body_zh: 参加海外展会之前，一家小型外贸公司在公证处办理了营业执照的公证。执照原件经过查验，公司章程也经过了审阅，三个工作日后，一份中英文对照的公证书交到了公司手里，公司随后把它和展位合同一起寄给了主办方。
body_en: Before taking part in an overseas trade fair, a small foreign trade company had its business license notarized at a notary office. The original license was examined and the articles of association were reviewed as well, three working days later a bilingual notarial certificate in Chinese and English reached the company, and the company then mailed it to the organizer together with the booth contract.

body_zh: 完整的书面合同在结构上包含三个部分。首部列明合同名称和签约双方的基本信息，正文约定标的物的数量和价款，还约定履行期限和违约责任，尾部留出签字盖章的位置，有的合同还附有清单或图纸，附件与正文装订在一起。
body_en: A complete written contract has three structural parts. The opening part states the title of the contract and basic information about both parties, the main body sets out the quantity and price of the subject matter as well as the performance period and liability for breach, and the closing part leaves space for signatures and seals, while some contracts also carry lists or drawings as attachments bound together with the main text.

body_zh: 按照档案管理的惯例，文书档案的保管期限分为永久和定期两种，定期又分为30年和10年。到期的档案由鉴定小组逐卷审核，仍有保存价值的继续保管，失去价值的经过登记和批准才会销毁，销毁清单同样归档保存。
body_en: By established archival practice, administrative records are kept either permanently or for a fixed period, and a fixed period is either 30 years or 10 years. When the period ends, an appraisal group reviews the records file by file, those still worth keeping stay in storage, those that have lost their value are destroyed only after registration and approval, and the list of destroyed records is itself filed and preserved.

body_zh: 柳荫社区的老年食堂每天中午提供两荤两素，过去一周，平均每天有118人就餐，人数最多的那一天达到146人。午餐每份标价15元，年满80岁的老人减免5元，这一周食堂一共售出午餐826份。
body_en: The senior canteen in the Liuyin community serves two meat dishes and two vegetable dishes every day at noon, and over the past week an average of 118 people ate there each day, with 146 on the busiest day. Each lunch is priced at 15 yuan, residents aged 80 or over get 5 yuan off, and the canteen sold 826 lunches in total that week.

body_zh: 办事大厅昨天上午一共发出排队号137个，下午又发出98个，每位办事群众平均等候14分钟。社保窗口的业务量最大，全天一共办结81件，税务窗口办结47件，另有5件因为材料不全，改为下周预约办理。
body_en: Yesterday morning the service hall issued 137 queue numbers in total, followed by another 98 in the afternoon, and each visitor waited 14 minutes on average. The social insurance window had the heaviest workload with 81 cases completed over the day, the tax window completed 47, and 5 other cases with incomplete documents were moved to appointments next week.

body_zh: 街心公园的中央是一片圆形草坪，四周环绕着一条红色塑胶步道，步道两侧每隔几十米就有一张木质长椅。公园的东北角立着一排健身器材，旁边的小亭子里装着一台饮水机，入夜以后，路灯把整片草坪照得很亮。
body_en: At the center of the small street corner park lies a round lawn, circled by a red rubber walking track, and wooden benches stand every few dozen meters along both sides of the track. A row of fitness equipment stands in the northeast corner of the park, a drinking water dispenser sits in the small pavilion next to it, and after dark the streetlights keep the whole lawn brightly lit.

body_zh: 新落成的办事大厅宽敞明亮，地面铺着浅色石材，正对入口的位置是导办台。大厅左侧排列着十八个综合窗口，右侧是自助服务区，摆放着打印机和查询机，靠窗的一面还留出了母婴室和休息区。
body_en: The newly completed service hall is spacious and bright, with pale stone on the floor and a guidance desk facing the entrance. Eighteen general service windows line the left side of the hall, the right side is an area of automated service machines with printers and information kiosks, and the side along the windows has space set aside for a nursing room and a rest area.

body_zh: 居民到物业前台登记车辆和房号，是办理电动车停放证的第一个环节。工作人员核对房屋信息并给车辆拍照存档，随后打印出带编号的停放证，贴在车尾的挡泥板上，车辆信息最后录入台账，全程不到十分钟。
body_en: Registering the vehicle and the apartment number at the property management front desk is the first step in getting a parking permit for an electric bike. Staff check the housing details and photograph the bike for the records, then print a numbered permit and stick it on the rear fender, and the vehicle details are finally entered in the ledger, all in less than ten minutes.

body_zh: 老小区的一栋六层住宅加装电梯，前后经历了五个阶段。征集各户意见用了一个月，方案设计和地下管线迁移又用了一个半月，土建和安装施工持续了两个月，竣工以后还经过质量检测和验收，电梯在九月正式投入使用。
body_en: Adding an elevator to a residential block with six floors in an old residential complex went through five stages. Gathering the views of every household took a month, the design and the relocation of underground pipes took another month and a half, construction and installation lasted two months, and after completion the work went through quality testing and acceptance before the elevator officially entered service in September.

body_zh: 上周六上午，小区广场上摆出了六张长桌，十几名志愿者在这里为居民免费修理电风扇和电饭锅，还帮忙磨剪刀。活动持续了三个多小时，修好各类物品七十多件，几件没能当场修好的电器被登记下来，约定下周送回。
body_en: Last Saturday morning six long tables were set up in the square of a residential compound, where more than ten volunteers repaired electric fans and rice cookers for residents free of charge and also sharpened scissors. The event lasted more than three hours and fixed over seventy items of all kinds, and the few appliances that could not be repaired on the spot were registered, to be returned the following week.

body_zh: 一条老街两侧新设了四个公共自行车站点，每个站点停放二十辆车。站点开放的第一周，附近居民借车超过一千次，管理方根据借还数据，又在地铁口加设了一个临时停放区，缓解早晚高峰时段车辆紧张的状况。
body_en: Four public bicycle stations were added along both sides of an old street, each holding twenty bikes. In the first week after they opened, nearby residents borrowed bikes more than a thousand times, and based on the borrowing and return data, the operator added a temporary parking area at a subway entrance to ease the shortage of bikes during the morning and evening rush hours.

body_zh: 首问负责制是不少办事大厅采用的一项规则。走进大厅以后，居民最先询问的那位工作人员负责引导到底，即使事项归别的窗口办理，这位工作人员也会把居民领过去，并说明办理时用到的材料，这样一来，来回奔波的情况就少了很多。
body_en: The first contact responsibility rule is used in many service halls. The staff member whom a resident asks first after entering the hall takes charge of guiding that resident all the way, so even when the matter is handled at another window, the same staff member takes the resident there and explains the documents the matter involves, and as a result wasted trips back and forth become much less common.

body_zh: 视障人士在人行道上行走时，会借助脚底和盲杖，分辨盲道砖表面的纹路。条形凸起表示可以顺着方向继续前进，圆点凸起表示前方路况有变化，这种砖通常铺在路口和台阶前，也出现在转弯处。
body_en: When visually impaired people walk along a sidewalk, they rely on the soles of their feet and a white cane to tell apart the textures on tactile paving tiles. Raised bars indicate that they can keep moving in that direction, while raised dots indicate a change in conditions ahead, and tiles of this kind are usually laid at crossings and in front of steps and also appear at turns.

body_zh: 街角的社区超市上月最后一个周六营业额接近四万元，客流量为1260人次，客单价在30元左右。当天卖得最好的是鸡蛋和牛奶，鸡蛋售出420盒，牛奶售出560瓶，冷柜里的速冻饺子在傍晚之前全部卖完。
body_en: The community supermarket on the street corner took in nearly forty thousand yuan on the last Saturday of last month, with 1260 customer visits and an average spend of about 30 yuan per purchase. The best sellers that day were eggs and milk, with 420 boxes of eggs and 560 bottles of milk sold, and the frozen dumplings in the freezer sold out before evening.

body_zh: 月末盘点时，文具店的账面库存为2150件，实际清点出2138件，相差12件，主要集中在签字笔和橡皮上。店长核对了最近一周的出货单，发现其中8件是漏记的赠品，另外4件的去向还在查找。
body_en: At the inventory count at the end of the month, the stationery shop had 2150 items in its book inventory but counted 2138 on hand, a gap of 12 items concentrated in pens and erasers. The shop manager went through the delivery notes from the past week and found that 8 of them were free gifts left off the records, while the whereabouts of the other 4 are still being traced.

body_zh: 进门右手边的货架共有五层，最上层摆着整箱的矿泉水，中间三层是各种口味的饼干和薯片，最下层放着大袋装的大米和面粉。每层隔板的边缘都贴着价签，普通商品用白色价签，促销商品的价签换成了醒目的黄色。
body_en: The shelving unit on the right of the entrance has five levels, with cases of bottled water on the top, cookies and chips in various flavors on the middle three, and large bags of rice and flour on the bottom. Price tags run along the edge of every shelf, ordinary goods carry white tags, and the tags on promotional items have been switched to a bright yellow.

body_zh: 两排倾斜的木架摆在水果店门口，苹果和橙子在架子上堆成了小山。这家店开在菜市场入口旁，只有十几平方米，靠墙放着一台冷藏柜，里面是切好装盒的西瓜和菠萝，收银台上方挂着一块小黑板，用粉笔标着当天的价格。
body_en: Two rows of slanted wooden racks stand outside the fruit shop, with apples and oranges piled on them like small hills. The shop sits beside the entrance of the food market and covers only a little over ten square meters, a refrigerated cabinet against the wall holds watermelon and pineapple already cut and boxed, and a small blackboard above the checkout shows the prices of the day in chalk.

body_zh: 酸奶从卸车到摆上货架，中间隔着一个晚上。收货员在卸货时逐箱核对数量和生产日期，确认无误才签收，货物随即转入冷库暂存。次日清晨，理货员按照先进先出的原则补货，把旧批次挪到前排，新批次放在后排。
body_en: Yogurt spends one night between being unloaded and reaching the shelves. While unloading, the receiving clerk checks the quantity and production date case by case and signs for the goods only when everything is correct, after which the goods go straight into cold storage. Early the next morning, the stock clerk restocks on the principle that older stock goes out first, moving older batches to the front and placing newer ones at the back.

body_zh: 周末促销的筹备从周三开始。采购部门选定参加打折的二十种商品，周四印好新价签，周五晚上闭店以后，店员撤下原价签，换上促销价签，同时更新收银机里的价格，到周六早上开门时，促销商品已经集中摆上了主通道的堆头。
body_en: Preparations for the weekend promotion begin on Wednesday. The purchasing department picks the twenty products to be discounted, new price tags are printed on Thursday, and after closing on Friday evening the staff take down the old tags, put up the promotional ones and update the prices in the cash registers, so that by the time the doors open on Saturday morning, the promoted goods are already stacked in displays along the main aisle.

body_zh: 每盒只卖9元的特价鸡蛋，让一家超市在上周日开门之前就排起了长队。备好的三百盒鸡蛋，不到一个小时就全部售出，超市随即从仓库调来两百盒，又在门口贴出告示，说明特价商品每人限购一盒。
body_en: Eggs on special at only 9 yuan a box drew a long line outside a supermarket last Sunday before it had even opened. The three hundred boxes set aside sold out in under an hour, so the supermarket brought in another two hundred from its warehouse and put up a notice at the door stating a limit of one box per customer for the special.

body_zh: 一瓶洗衣液在收银台扫出的价格比货架价签高了5元，顾客结账时当场指了出来。收银员核实后确认是价签没有及时更换，按价签上的价格收了款。当晚闭店前，门店把全部价签排查了一遍，又找出7处同样的问题。
body_en: At the checkout, a bottle of laundry detergent scanned at 5 yuan more than the price on the shelf tag, and the customer pointed this out on the spot. The cashier checked and confirmed that the tag had not been updated in time, then charged the price shown on the tag. Before closing that night, the store went through all of its price tags and found 7 more cases of the same problem.

body_zh: 在超市里，与视线齐平的那层货架最容易被顾客看到，销量较高的品种往往摆在这里，黄金层的说法就是这么来的。体积大或分量重的商品多放在最下层，既方便顾客搬取，也能降低货架倾倒的风险。
body_en: In supermarkets, the shelf at eye level is the one shoppers notice most easily, so items that sell well are often placed there, which is where the term golden shelf comes from. Bulky or heavy goods mostly go on the bottom shelf, which makes them easier for shoppers to lift and also lowers the risk of the shelving tipping over.

body_zh: 第二件半价的促销方式，实际上相当于两件商品一起打七五折。以标价20元的洗发水为例，第一瓶付20元，第二瓶付10元，两瓶合计付30元，平均下来每瓶15元，只买一瓶的顾客则仍按原价付款。
body_en: A promotion offering the second item at half price is in effect the same as a 25 percent discount on two items bought together. Taking a shampoo priced at 20 yuan as an example, the first bottle costs 20 yuan and the second 10 yuan, making 30 yuan for the pair, or 15 yuan per bottle on average, while a customer who buys only one bottle still pays the full price.
